\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}
Information erasure carries a thermodynamic cost \cite{landauer1961}. The cost is small in absolute terms, but it matters for dense computing hardware because every bit of heat must eventually leave the chip, and the chips keep getting denser. We make this precise in Section~\ref{sec:model}.
\section{Model}\label{sec:model}
Let $S = k_B \ln 2$ be the entropy change per erased bit.
